race.comment: POLYGLOT (5) settled handy then finished a shade too well in an 1100m BM78 at Rosehill last start. Not sure 1000m is his optimum trip but the pace will be a cracker and it is a long run home. Steps up to open company but drops 7kgs and love that winning Sydney form. Mr Consistency TALTARNI FIELDS (2) added to his fine record with a tough win over 1200m at Doomben last time, coming from a long way back with a well-timed run. Not as effective at Eagle Farm and does come back to 1000m, but he is going too well to knock. CHAKRA BOY (3) scored a gutsy win under 60kgs at the Sunshine Coast recently when second-up from a spell. Takes on better horses today but he drops 5kgs and can improve further at the third run back. Class runner CIFRADO (1) last raced when beaten narrowly in the Listed Glasshouse eight weeks ago. Five-time stakes winner who looks well in after Bella's claim.
